Article.ArticleTitle: Methylation of C(sp3)-H/C(sp2)-H Bonds with Methanol Catalyzed by Cobalt System.

Abstract.AbstractText: A highly efficient Co-based catalytic system, composed of a commercially available Co salt, a tetradentate phosphine ligand P(CH2CH2PPh2)3(PP3), and a base (denoted as [Co]/PP3/base), is developed for the methylation of C(sp3)-H and C(sp2)-H bonds using methanol as a methylating reagent. The Co(BF4)2·6H2O/PP3/K2CO3 catalytic system showed high catalytic activity for the methylation of C-H bonds in aryl alkyl ketones, aryl acetonitriles, and indoles, with wide substrate scope and good functional group tolerance, and methyl-substituted products were obtained in good to excellent yields at 100 °C. This cheap, readily available, and highly efficient Co-based catalytic system may have promising applications in methylation reaction using methanol.
